why: Arrows and fish-bones take turns like a chessboard, so the missing box holds a fish-bone. The grid also repeats along the diagonal: the box at row 1, column 1 matches row 2, column 2, so row 2, column 3 matches row 1, column 2 - a fish-bone slanting up to the right. That is option 2. Option 3 has no forked ends, so it is not a fish-bone.
trick: Check diagonals as well as rows and columns in 3x3 grids.
